IntVectorProperty.name: Shot
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: The values of this property sets the case Shot number.

IntVectorProperty.name: Run
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: The values of this property sets the case Run number.

StringVectorProperty.name: User
StringVectorProperty.label: User
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the user for the UAL Database.

StringVectorProperty.name: Device
StringVectorProperty.label: Device
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the Device for the UAL Database.

StringVectorProperty.name: LoadIDS
StringVectorProperty.label: Edge IDS
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the IDS from which the grid geometry and plasma state are to be read. Note: If required, the grid geometry can be read from other IDS by setting the 'Edge IDS grid' option in advanced options.

StringVectorProperty.name: IDSPlasmaStateSource
StringVectorProperty.label: Edge IDS plasma state source
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the IDS from which the plasma state is to be read in the case when the grid geometry of one IDS corresponds to multiple IDS plasma states. In case this option is not set, the plasma state is taken from the IDS specified in the main 'Edge IDS' option.

IntVectorProperty.name: EdgeSourcesSourceID
IntVectorProperty.label: .source(#)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the edge_sources.source(:) IDS structure array index. Python notation (0, 1, 2, ...). Default value = 0.

IntVectorProperty.name: EdgeTransportModelID
IntVectorProperty.label: .model(#)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the edge_transport.model(:) IDS structure array index. Python notation (0, 1, 2, ...). Default value = 0.

IntVectorProperty.name: GGDslice
IntVectorProperty.label: .ggd(#)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: The values of this property sets the GGD structure array index. Python notation (0, 1, 2, ...). Default value = 0.

IntVectorProperty.name: IDSListCheckBox
IntVectorProperty.label: Show list of available IDS Shot/Run cases
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: This checkbox opens the list of available IDSs for specified user.

StringVectorProperty.name: ShotRunList
StringVectorProperty.label: IDS List
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: List of available Shot/Run-s for specified user.
